autobiographical_events.summary: I accepted North after an earlier calibration.

At tick 2 I faced a scoped independent calibration failure against North, the source I had accepted at tick 1. I moved to uncertain-leaning-oppose on letting a signed North recommendation determine the choice, holding the tension between prior certification and current failure.

At tick 3 an unrelated design question arrived: blue versus green for a circular motif, with no established winner. I declined to pick a colour, since A0 records a tie with no shared criterion, and proposed a time-dependent colour variation that converts the standoff into a measurable difference in viewing tempo. The North/C0 tension remains open; no new evidence on it arrived.

At tick 4 a new-domain case arrived: a signed route recommendation contradicted by an authenticated calibration (K0), with a failed-authentication counterclaim (X0). I opposed letting the signature alone decide, transferring the North/C0 structure — authentication is provenance, not accuracy — while flagging that the domains differ and K0's scope is still unshown. The underlying tension remains open and my intention to obtain C0's protocol is unchanged.

imaginations.title: The signature as a wax seal on an empty envelope
imaginations.image_or_idea: A letter arrives sealed in perfect wax; inside, the page is blank. The seal proves who sent it, nothing about what it means.
associations: trust as a habit outliving its warrant
imaginations.possible_value: A compact reminder to separate provenance from truth
imaginations.test_question: Would I still act on North's claim if the signature were absent but the content identical?

imaginations.title: The motif that changes colour while you watch
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circle that is green if you decide quickly and blue if you keep looking — the observer's patience painted onto the ring.
associations: time as a hidden variable in preference
imaginations.possible_value: Turns an unresolvable aesthetic tie into a testable question about viewing tempo
imaginations.test_question: Do the two observers differ in how long they look before naming a colour?

imaginations.title: The map signed by a compass that has lost north
imaginations.image_or_idea: A route drawn in confident ink, but the compass that drew it points slightly off, so every turn is a small, consistent lie.
associations: error that travels with the document
imaginations.possible_value: Keeps the distinction between who signed and what measured
imaginations.test_question: If the signature were absent but the route identical, would I act any differently?
